publications.paper_id: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Paper-II Series 'C'.pdf
publications.explanation: C, reward power. Praise, recognition and attention can be valued non-monetary rewards, so offering them can influence behaviour. Legitimate power comes from recognised authority or a role; expert power from knowledge or skill; referent power from identification with or admiration for a person. The question focuses on what the person can give others, rather than on their office, expertise or personal appeal. [OpenStax, Organizational Behavior: Leader Emergence](https://openstax.org/books/organizational-behavior/pages/12-3-leader-emergence).

publications.paper_id: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Paper-II Series 'C'.pdf
publications.explanation: D is the intended choice: use visual aids and props to stimulate interest. This changes the way the material is presented when the audience appears disengaged. B embarrasses listeners; C proposes speeding up, which may make the talk harder to follow. A can also be constructive in a real presentation, because feedback can reveal confusion or lack of interest. The exam's choice of D is a judgement among these alternatives, not a rule that visual aids are always better than audience feedback. Choose aids that clarify the message rather than merely adding decoration.
